enchantments.tooltip: Speed +30%: +30% enhancement bonus to movement speed, 15% bonus to attack speed.

Proof Against Disease +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural diseases. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical diseases, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical diseases with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).

Proof Against Poison +11: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +11 Enhancement bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 12 + their Fortitude save).
Damage Reduction 15/-: Reduces all physical damage by 15.
